Talia (AE): Hey team — Vela Retail wants to onboard a custom classifier for return-fraud detection. They want private deployment (VPC) + PI-sensitive handling. Can we scope next steps?
Derek (Solutions Eng): Thanks — can you ask them for an eval set (CSV), label schema, and expected QPS / latency SLOs? Also which model family? They mentioned "retail-fraud-13b-ft" but we should confirm.
Talia (AE): I'll get the CSV. They expect ~30 reqs/s peak, 50ms token latency per our SLA target if possible. They prefer a 7–13B model, quantized is fine.  
Derek (Solutions Eng): OK. For onboarding checklist:
- receive eval set + schema
- run safety scan (PII/PI) and redact as needed
- run initial quality eval (precision/recall, F1)
- perf bench on Dedicated vs. Private
- plan canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
Sasha (CS): Heads-up — Vela is at renewal in 9 weeks. Smooth onboarding = major upsell. We should prioritize if they hit blockers. 
Eva (Privacy): Need to confirm data residency + DPA terms. For any PII we must enforce KMS encryption and no logs retained beyond 30 days unless agreed. Also require an interface for opt-out. 
Derek (Solutions Eng): For the safety checklist, we'll enable prefix/KV caching off for PHI traffic and add redaction hook. Can we get a sample of sensitive fields so we can map detection rules?
Talia (AE): Customer to share sample schema today. I'll book a 30m tech sync tomorrow at 11am PT. 
OnboardBot: Ticket created: ONB-4829 — Vela Retail custom classifier onboarding. Assigned: Derek. Due: 2026-02-10. 
Sasha (CS): Proposed owners: Derek (eng lead), Talia (customer), Eva (privacy), Sasha (CS). I'll follow up weekly. :thumbsup:
